title: How Trump Decided to Go to War
partialText: President Trump’s embrace of military action in Iran was set off by the determination of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel to end diplomatic negotiations. Our investigative reporter Mark Mazzetti describes how few of Mr. Trump’s advisers voiced opposition.

title: Iran Made Secret Outreach After Strikes, Highlighting Trump’s Challenge
partialText: President Trump is beginning to consider what sort of Iranian government might come next, as the U.S.-Israeli assault continues.

title: U.S. Submarine Torpedoed Iranian Warship Off Sri Lanka as Conflict Widens
partialText: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said it was the first such strike since World War II. The Sri Lankan authorities said they had rescued 32 sailors from the crew of 180.

title: These American Service Members Have Died in the Iran Conflict
partialText: They were from Nebraska, Florida, Iowa and Minnesota. One was wrapping up his final deployment and hoped to open a martial arts studio.

partialText: Plus, the fight over daylight saving time.

title: Talarico’s Win in Texas Shows That Nice Guys Can Finish First
partialText: At a moment when many Democrats are campaigning on rage and resistance, James Talarico took a different tack in his campaign in the Texas Senate primary.

title: How RFK Jr. Is Trying to Revamp Medical School
partialText: The health secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., has tapped into an old debate about how much doctors should know about nutrition. But some of his ideas, and tactics, concern medical experts.

title: With Fuel Running Out and Canadian Flights Suspended, Cuba’s Tourism Is Collapsing
partialText: The Trump administration’s decision to cut off foreign oil to the island is devastating its tourism industry, a key source of income for a government being pushed to the edge.

title: Chimpanzees Are Really Into Crystals

title: Bessent Says Global Tariffs Will Rise to 15% This Week

title: Top Fed Official, Wary of Inflation, Calls for Extended Rate Pause
partialText: Beth M. Hammack, head of the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, says it is too early to gauge the economic impact of the Iran war and backs holding interest rates steady for “quite some time.”

title: U.S. Takes Military Action in Ecuador Against ‘Terrorist Organizations’
partialText: U.S. Special Forces soldiers are advising and supporting Ecuadorean commandos on raids across the country against suspected drug shipment facilities and other drug-related sites.

title: Paramount-Warner Deal Promises to Shake Up Streaming
partialText: The deal would put the combined company in the same league as Disney and Amazon. But Netflix and YouTube will still easily outrank everyone.

partialText: The Metropolitan Police of London said that it had arrested three people under the National Security Act.
